Avalanche in Nepal's Himalayas kills at least 14, leaves others missing

An avalanche at the Himlung Himal Base Camp in Nepal has resulted in the deaths of at least 14 Nepali workers and left 10 to 14 others missing. The incident occurred while workers were preparing the mountain camp for climbers. Rescuers have recovered some bodies, with fresh visuals showing the snow-covered slope. The event has revived trauma from previous incidents in the Rasuwa region and has left families in Bihar, India, waiting for news of their missing relatives.
